thread:
luis: morning all 12 opened a tiny PR to add Brazil + North Africa regional availability notes and a Go SDK snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/2583. looking for legal + runtime confirmation on residency phrasing and whether to show domain-based vs header-based examples.

emma: thanks. prefer env var pattern (REDWOOD_REGION) in examples to match other SDKs. can you add a short sentence explaining latency vs residency (nearby region reduces latency; residency may affect fallback)?

luis: added that. here's the Go snippet i included:
```go
// go example
os.Setenv("REDWOOD_REGION", "sa-brazil-1")
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{APIKey: os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), Region: os.Getenv("REDWOOD_REGION")})
resp, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateRequest{Prompt: "Olá"})
```

ryan: eng-runtime confirm: regional domains are api.<region>.redwood.ai (e.g., api.sa-brazil-1.redwood.ai). We keep the X-Redwood-Region header for older clients, but recommend customers use the regional domain for clearer routing and latency. KV cache is cluster-local; Dedicated/Private are region-local unless replication requested. Hosted does read-fallback across regions during failover. OK to land.

legal: copy check: avoid absolutes like "data never leaves the region". Suggested safe phrasing: "For Hosted plans, customer content is processed and stored in the selected region where available. For Dedicated and Private deployments, residency controls are available via contract (see Data Processing Addendum: https://redwood.example.com/dpa). Some operational telemetry and backups may be processed outside the selected region; see the DPA for details."

luis: thanks, added legal wording and a small footnote about logs/backups. also added a CLI migration example with both domain and header variants:
```bash
# recommended: regional domain
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.sa-brazil-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ole1"}'
# legacy header fallback
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: sa-brazil-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ole1"}'
```

emma: tiny nit: add a one-line migration checklist: update SDK minor to pick up region param, replace global domain with regional domain, remove custom header if moving to domain routing.

luis: added checklist. docs-bot: CI?

docs-bot: Docs CI: \u2705 3/3 checks passed (links, lint, preview). Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/pr-2583

ryan: approved runtime bits. legal: approved?

legal: approved. one more footnote request: mention Dedicated onboarding contact for contractual residency.

luis: added contact link and merged after CI. thanks everyone! :tada:
